aboutUsObj.paragraphOne: We believe that every great journey begins with reliable information, and every unforgettable experience starts with making the right choice. That is why we created a platform where travelers, food lovers, and people seeking relaxation can discover everything they need in one convenient place.
aboutUsObj.paragraphTwo: Our mission is to inspire people to explore new destinations, experience different cultures, enjoy exceptional cuisine, and create lasting memories. We carefully collect, organize, and present information to ensure that it is accurate, trustworthy, and easy to access.
aboutUsObj.paragraphThree: Our team is committed to continuously improving the quality of our services, updating our content, and creating the best possible experience for every visitor. We pay close attention to every detail, from the usability of our website to the reliability of the information we provide.
aboutUsObj.paragraphFour: We understand that your time is valuable. For this reason, we strive to make every search simple, efficient, and enjoyable by offering clear information that helps you make confident decisions.
aboutUsObj.paragraphFive: Our vision is to build a trusted community where people can find inspiration, discover exciting destinations, explore new flavors,and choose the perfect place to relax.
aboutUsObj.paragraphSix: Whether you are planning your next adventure, searching for a memorable restaurant, or simply looking for ideas, we are here to support your journey.

paragraph.one: Basic provisions regarding the use of the website, user data, and their protection.
paragraph.one_dot_one: This Privacy Policy defines the basic principles of collecting, using, storing, and protecting user data while using the “Travel Notes” website.
paragraph.one_dot_one_two: “Travel Notes” is an educational web project created to demonstrate modern web technologies and the functionality of a website focused on travel.
paragraph.one_dot_one_three: Using the website means that the user has read and understood this Privacy Policy.
paragraph.one_dot_two: The main purpose of the website is to provide informational content about travel, interesting places, food, and relaxation.
paragraph.one_dot_two_two: The website includes Travel, Food, and Relax sections where users can explore relevant content.
paragraph.one_dot_two_three: Some website features are available only to registered users.
paragraph.one_dot_three: During registration and the use of certain website features, the following data may be used: username, email address, password, user profile information, and notification-related data.
paragraph.one_dot_three_two: The user is responsible for the accuracy of the information they provide.
paragraph.one_dot_four: User data is used to provide the main functionality of the website.
paragraph.one_dot_five: User passwords are not stored in plain text. They are hashed using the bcrypt technology.
paragraph.one_dot_five_two: Access token and refresh token mechanisms are used for user authentication.
paragraph.one_dot_five_three: The website may use the browser's Local Storage to maintain authentication and store certain user preferences.
paragraph.one_dot_six: Registered users can manage their accounts through the Settings section.
paragraph.one_dot_six_two: Users can update their profile information, change their password, log out, or delete their account.
paragraph.one_dot_six_three: When an account is deleted, the corresponding user data may be removed from the project's database.
paragraph.one_dot_seven: The “Travel Notes” website was created exclusively for educational and demonstration purposes.
paragraph.one_dot_seven_two: The purpose of the project is to demonstrate the use of modern frontend and backend technologies, including user registration, authentication, database operations, profile management, and a notification system.
paragraph.one_dot_seven_three: The website is not a travel agency, booking system, or payment platform.
paragraph.one_dot_seven_four: The website's functionality and content may change during the development of the project.
